title: Compound-DApp
tagline: Build a DApp to use Compound SDK
description:
Learn and try out the compound SDK: https://compound.finance/docs/compound-js
Build a fully functional DApp to lend and borrow using Compound protocol

It has three buttons, "Connection wallet", "Supply", and "Borrow".
Once wallet is connected, it'll enable supply and borrow buttons.
and user can enter amount to supply or borrow
how_its_made:
This project is using compound.js to create a DeFi dapp that supply/borrow tokens.

We get a free HTML template online and build from there.

All codes are in HTML and javascript.

We just use sublime to edit the code.

For local environment, we use cygwin with node.js and run a local http server.
